about: Client talent loadout strings from real WoW Forever SimC addon exports (talents=), with the engine talent string each decodes to. Used by packages/importers/src/loadout.test.ts. Character names and realms in the .simc files are replaced.

exports.source: A real export from a player's client, added in commit 0fab8b1.
exports.evidence: 33 points, a legal Enhancement/Restoration tree, string ends at the last node. The level 20 export below (another character, older client) selects a subset of the same Enhancement nodes.

16 points: what a level 20 character has with the Talented legacy perk at rank 5 (this older addon writes no legacy_talents line). Legal in that client's tree, where Improved Ghost Wolf sat in Enhancement's second row (SimC trait data for 70334 and 70450); today's tree has it in the fourth row, so the importer refuses the build (DEFAULT-05) rather than make an illegal tree. Same tree hash as the level 42 export, so the hash does not cover rows.

Endurance Training 5/5, Focused Fire 1/2: 6 of 7 points (Talented 5). The export's own stats show the partial rank: weapon damage percent 1.01 (Focused Fire: +1% damage per rank while the pet is out). Reading it with one node more or less anywhere gives no other legal build. The string ends exactly at the last node.

Improved Corruption 5/5, the usual first five warlock points. Legal; nothing past it. A one-node shift would read the row-0 neighbour instead (also legal), so this one rests on the node table matching Wowhead's node ids.

Improved Heroic Strike 2/3, Improved Rend 3/3, Improved Tactical Mastery 1 (row 2 after 5 in row 1): legal, two partial ranks. Exported from the 52-node tree; Reckless Swings (the 53rd node, last in order) was added in 70790, so current exports likely carry another hash.
